answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with stake-weighted admission: every identity locks collateral, and a beacon samples identities for each vote or contract, with influence proportional to locked stake. An identity that signs conflicting outcomes is publicly provable and loses its collateral. Splitting one stake into a garden of fake accounts gives no extra voting power, so the attacker must acquire and risk capital proportional to control. The registry can use jade as a harmless role name.
